envelope.description: Export migrateHeads with an optional id filter

body.title: Export migrateHeads with an optional id filter
body.summary: Export migrateHeads from apply.ts with an optional trailing set of artifact ids; the full conversion calls it unchanged. Limit its documented unreadable error to a head that has a meta object but no body object. Add a negative test that heads outside the filter are byte-for-byte unchanged and get no new log entries, and a test that the unfiltered call migrates the same heads as before.
acceptanceChecks: With the filter, heads outside the set are neither read for writing nor changed, and get no new log entries
Without the filter, the full conversion migrates the same heads as before

tests.name: convert-apply.test.ts: migrateHeads with an id filter leaves heads outside the filter unchanged with no new log entries
convert-apply.test.ts: the full conversion migrates the same heads as before with no id filter
